title: Punk Graffiti Artist
description: A female punk with blue spiky mohawk and black-and-yellow striped bodysuit covered in dripping paint stands in a decaying, moss-covered stone structure. She is actively spray-painting vibrant purple graffiti onto a pillar while surrounded by swirling dark clouds, floating paint drips, and decaying architectural elements.
prompt: A rebellious female punk with bright blue spiky mohawk and dramatic black face paint, wearing a form-fitting yellow and black vertically striped bodysuit, stands dynamically in a ruined moss-covered stone building. She holds a spray can in one hand and paints purple graffiti on a pillar while colorful paint drips and splatters fly through the air. Dark swirling stormy clouds fill the sky, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting with visible brush strokes.
